desc: Implement the prefix-sum plus binomial expansion solution in Python, reading stdin and writing stdout.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(K,t) and signs (-1)^(K-t) modulo 998244353.
Initialize power_sums[0] = 1 for the empty prefix S_0 = 0 and all other power_sums[p] = 0.
For each prefix sum S_j modulo 998244353, compute powers S_j^t for 0 <= t <= K and add the binomial contribution using previously seen prefix sums only.
Update power_sums[p] += S_j^p after adding the contribution, with S_j^0 = 1.
Verify edge cases: all A_i = 0, K = 1, large N, modulo wraparound, and no self-pairing of prefix sums.
Run the provided sample tests and ensure the solution passes.
